The kindest people in whole of Mui Ne with delicious food to serve and great surfing lessons!
Sep 2024 • Solo
I highly recommend this place to anyone in Mui Ne! I stayed in Mui Ne for 2 days and both days I went to this lovely restaurant. Mr. Lee and his wife are the sweetest people I’ve met in Vietnam so far. So helpful, gentle and welcoming! The food was also very delicious! Especially the quesadilla and the mango sticky rice! 

I also went surfing with Mr. Lee and it were the best two hours of my trip to Mui Ne. Mr. Lee explains everything very well and he gave me a lot of useful tips that I will never forget. He is so easy to talk to and give me a lot of (surf)advice :) My surfing skills are very much improved! Thank you so much for everything! I hope to come back someday :)

Love this beautiful place
Jun 2024 • Couples
I absolutely love this place and the family who run it, especially the wee fella with his apron on serving with a wee cheeky smile on his face. We have been travelling for nearly 10 months between Asia and Australia, as we were in Mui Ne for 1 month in March, the first place we came back to in June was here for the vegetable noodle soup, which is delicious. 

Delicious food and inexpensive for the quality, as made fresh every time.

If I could give 10 stars I would as it is so delicious and heartwarming being here.

Wonderful breakfast spot
May 2024 • Solo
I came here both mornings I was in Mui Ne. The food was delicious, I had avocado toast one day and the fruit, musli and yoghurt bowl the next. The food was so fresh and the portion sizes were incredibly generous. The people serving the food make this place extra special. It’s a family run place and I enjoyed talking to them while I was here, they were all very kind and attentive and had great conversations. Would highly recommend to anyone staying in Mui Ne. Also the coconut and yoghurt coffees are amazing!
